name: Telebi de Nugasareta Onna-tachi
original_name: テレビで脱がされた女たち
source:
Es-TV is the largest television network in Japan.
It's the dream of many talents to land a spot on one of its reality shows.
Get on Es-TV and your star of fame will instantly rise!

But...
There's one thing about Es-TV.
All the programming is X-rated!

Some reality shows are obviously pornographic based on the title,
while others are obscure and downright strange... just what makes them X-rated...? 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130143.html]DLSite English[/url]]
